Messages.Author: Morgan Vening
Messages.Body:
Repeat Actions
- I know a Vampire cannot do the same action, or play the same direct
modifier (two Lost in the Crowds to boost stealth on a single action),
but where does that end?

Example, I have a Vampire in Combat. Can I use a Flash to Maneuver,
then a Flash to Press? Can I use a Flash to Press, then in the next
round, a Flash to Maneuver? What about a Flash to Maneuver, then again
to Maneuver in the next round?

Crusher (Brujah)
- Can Crusher burn a blood to Dodge after a strike has been declared?

Example, Crusher Bum's Rushes someone. Crusher declares a Hand Strike
(no card), opp plays big whammy. Can Crusher Dodge? If so, would this
apply even if Crusher had played say Thrown Sewer Lid?

Blessing of Chaos
- If the vampire attempts to block, and then the attempt is
unsuccessful, does the acting vampire still have the "no action mod
requiring dem/chi/dom/pre" caveat?
- If yes, can the vampire with this attempt to block any and every
action that is stealthed, and not attempt to intercept, knowing the
above is going to happen?

Morgan Vening

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Morgan Vening wrote:
> Repeat Actions
> - I know a Vampire cannot do the same action, or play the same direct
> modifier (two Lost in the Crowds to boost stealth on a single action),
> but where does that end?

A vampire cannot play the same action card to take an action twice
in a single turn.

He could take the same action, say hunt, twice in a turn however.

The restriction ends where the rules stop placing restrictions.

> Example, I have a Vampire in Combat. Can I use a Flash to Maneuver,
> then a Flash to Press? Can I use a Flash to Press, then in the next
> round, a Flash to Maneuver? What about a Flash to Maneuver, then again
> to Maneuver in the next round?

Yes. The rules do not restrict repeating combat cards.

> Crusher (Brujah)
> - Can Crusher burn a blood to Dodge after a strike has been declared?

No.

> Example, Crusher Bum's Rushes someone. Crusher declares a Hand Strike
> (no card), opp plays big whammy. Can Crusher Dodge? If so, would this
> apply even if Crusher had played say Thrown Sewer Lid?

Moot. He only gets one strike each strike.
He'd have to use a card effect that allows him to change his declared
strike in order to change his declared strike.

> Blessing of Chaos
> - If the vampire attempts to block, and then the attempt is
> unsuccessful, does the acting vampire still have the "no action mod
> requiring dem/chi/dom/pre" caveat?

Yes.

> - If yes, can the vampire with this attempt to block any and every
> action that is stealthed, and not attempt to intercept, knowing the
> above is going to happen?

Only the ones he is allowed to block, but yes.
